ROHAN KUMBHAR

Technical Product Owner

rohankumbhar88@gmail.com | +91 9225517136 | Pune, Maharashtra | www.linkedin.com/in/rohan-kumbhar-po

Professional Summary

AI Technical Product Owner with 9+ years leading digital products across banking, payments, US healthcare, and logistics , owning platforms with 1M+ daily active users and 1M+ daily transactions at 99.8% uptime. Proven leader of AI/Gen AI-powered automation and analytics initiatives, partnering with cross-functional teams of 25+ engineers across 3+ squads to deliver 30% faster operational decision-making, 25% less rework, and a 15% lift in customer retention. Combines a software engineering background with SAFe/Scrum agile leadership, Microsoft Azure expertise, and US healthcare domain knowledge to drive end-to-end delivery of AI-powered programs, translating business, clinical, and regulatory needs into scalable, revenue-driving product outcomes.

Certifications

SAFe Product Owner Product Manager (POPM) - Scaled Agile

Professional Scrum Product Owner I (PSPO I) - Scrum.org

Certified Scrum Master (CSM) - Scrum Alliance

Education

Shivaji University, Kolhapur

Bachelor of Engineering (BE) | Computer Sciences and Engineering | 2014

Professional Skills

Product Management: Product Vision & Strategy, Roadmap Planning, Product Discovery, MVP Definition, Backlog Prioritization, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Feature Prioritization, Customer Journey Mapping, Market & Competitive Analysis, GTM Strategy, BRD, UAT, PLM, Business Analysis, ROI, Stakeholder Management & Alignment, User Research

Agile Delivery: Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, PI Planning, Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, Release Planning & Management, Retrospectives, ART Engineer Coordination

Data & Analytics: KPI Definition, OKR Tracking, Product Analytics, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Google Analytics, Databricks, Performance Monitoring, Data-Driven Decision Making, API Integration

Tools & Platforms: Jira, Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, Bitbucket, Visual Studio, Confluence, GitHub, Jenkins, AWS, GCP

Technical Skills: Angular, React.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, RESTful APIs, Microservices, AI, ML, Generative AI

Domain Expertise: Banking, Payments, US Healthcare, Logistics, Enterprise SaaS, Shipping, Capital Markets, IoT

Soft Skills: Strategic Thinking, Communication, Leadership, Problem Solving, Collaboration & Teamwork, Cross-Functional Alignment

Work Experience

Aligned Automation                                                                                                                      August 2025 – Jan 2026

Technical Product Owner 	Pune, Maharashtra, India

Lead end-to-end product ownership for enterprise automation platform, defining product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with business objectives and customer needs

Drive 30% improvement in operational decision-making speed through implementation of real-time analytics dash boards and automated reporting workflows

Owned AI powered automation initiatives including Gen AI, ML, intelligent workflow automation, and predictive analytics features.

Facilitate PI Planning, sprint planning, and backlog refinement sessions with cross-functional teams of 15+ members including engineering, UX, and data analytics

Engaged executive leadership, business sponsors, and clients to define AI roadmaps, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and delivery excellence across multidisciplinary teams

Bit Hub Technology                                                                                                                        Feb 2024 – Aug 2025

Data Product Owner	Pune, Maharashtra, India

Own product roadmap for data analytics platform serving banking and US healthcare clients, managing backlog of 200+ features and driving value-based prioritization

Deliver 30+ hours per month in productivity gains through workflow automation and data pipeline optimization, directly impacting team efficiency and customer satisfaction

Define and track OKRs and KPIs using Power BI, SQL, and Databricks, providing leadership with actionable insights on product performance and user engagement metrics

Partnered with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and React.js development teams to deliver data visualization and analytics products.

Defined user stories and acceptance criteria for Electronic Health Records (EHR), patient workflow automation, and predictive analytics features.

Defined AI/ML powered analytics features including predictive dashboards, anomaly detection, forecasting, and intelligent reporting.

Owned and managed the AI product backlog, translating business, clinical, and regulatory needs into clear features, user stories, and acceptance criteria in partnership with clinical stakeholders and compliance teams.

Collaborated with AI architects on solution design, model training workflows, and deployment pipelines hosted on Microsoft Azure, ensuring alignment across engineering, data science, and clinical teams.

Wipro Technologies                                                                                                                           May 2022 - Jan 2024

Scrum Product Owner	Pune, Maharashtra, India

Managed product backlog for payments processing platform handling 1M+ daily transactions, ensuring high avail- ability and regulatory compliance

Collaborated with 3 engineering squads (25+ developers) to deliver quarterly releases, balancing feature development with technical debt reduction

Introduced Artificial Intelligence based fraud detection, transaction risk scoring, and payment anomaly detection initiatives.

Worked on Capital Markets and Investment Banking domain initiatives, supporting trade lifecycle management, portfolio reporting, and financial data analytics.

Defined acceptance criteria and conducted UAT for critical payment flows, achieving 99.8% transaction success rate

Worked closely with business stakeholders to align product priorities with revenue goals, contributing to 15% increase in customer retention

Persistent  Systems                                                                                                                          Nov 2020 - May 2022

Associate Product Owner	Pune, Maharashtra, India

Supported product ownership for healthcare and logistics platforms, writing user stories, managing backlogs, and coordinating with development teams

Collaborated with React.js development teams to improve user experience and dashboard usability.

Participated in SAFe PI Planning sessions, aligning team objectives with program-level goals and dependencies

Conducted market research and competitive analysis to inform product strategy and feature prioritization

Reduced rework by 25% through implementation of comprehensive acceptance criteria and stakeholder validation processes

Web Hub Technology                                                                                                                      May 2016 - Nov 2020

Software Engineer	Pune, Maharashtra, India

Developed responsive, scalable web applications using Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3 for banking and enterprise clients

Built reusable UI component library reducing development time by 35% and ensuring consistent user experience across products

Integrated RESTful APIs and third-party services, implementing error handling and data validation for robust frontend solutions

Mentored junior developers on Angular best practices, TypeScript patterns, and frontend architecture principle
